(17, [17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17], 'def transform(grid):
    """Expand a centered marker into diagonal rays and a periodic inner lattice."""
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = n // 2
    out = [[0 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            distance = abs(c - center)
            if distance == r:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif distance < r and (c - r - center) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
